signals.entity: Komercni banka / Moneta / Air Bank / UniCredit Bank CZ (shared ATM network)
signals.signal: UniCredit Bank joined the four-bank shared DEPOSIT ATM network on 16/02/2026, adding 144 deposit ATMs and taking the shared deposit pool to 'nearly 1,000'. Single-deposit cap raised from CZK 300,000 to CZK 350,000 across the whole shared network. ~120 ATMs relocated from over-served city locations to under-served municipalities. January 2026 alone: >155,000 shared deposits worth nearly CZK 2bn; 1.8m shared deposits since the Aug-2024 launch. KB clients can now deposit using a digitalised card in a phone or smartwatch (already live for Moneta and Air Bank).
signals.implies: Cash-recycling/deposit ATM hardware, cardless/NFC-wallet deposit software, shared-network transaction switching and monitoring.
signals.followup: Identify the supplier of the NFC/wallet deposit application layer and the shared-network routing/switch.

signals.signal: Moneta discloses the pooled four-bank network is now over 1,900 ATMs, of which ~960 accept deposits. Per-bank contributions: Komercni banka 745, Moneta 540+, Air Bank 374, UniCredit Bank 258.
signals.implies: Per-bank fleet sizing for ATM/recycler replacement bids and managed services.
signals.followup: Confirm deposit-capable split per bank and each bank's OEM mix.

signals.signal: On 17/07/2026 Moneta became the FIRST Czech bank to accept EURO banknote deposits at its ATMs - live in all regional capitals and in border regions. Free of charge, requires a EUR account and card, credited within minutes.
signals.implies: Multi-currency cash-acceptance recyclers, note-validation/denomination software, cash forecasting.
signals.followup: Which OEM/recycler model supports the EUR cassette at Moneta and how many units are enabled.

signals.signal: Moneta plans to expand COIN-deposit machines (mincomaty) from 6 branches to a further ~20 during 2026, and to introduce MULTICURRENCY ATMs allowing EUR cash withdrawal 'where it makes sense'; only after that will it consider further cutting manned cash desks. Moneta cut cash desks during 2025 from all 134 branches to 41 of 123.
signals.source_name: Penize.cz - Kolik maji banky pobocek, pokladen a co s nimi planuji
signals.implies: Coin deposit machines, multi-currency dispense recyclers, branch cash automation.
signals.followup: Chase Moneta procurement for the ~20 coin machines and the multicurrency ATM programme.

signals.signal: At 01/01/2026 the 13 retail banks ran 1,426 branches of which only 548 still had a manned cash desk, versus 1,503 branches / 687 cash desks in Aug-2024. Per bank at 01/01/2026: Ceska sporitelna 329 (115 with cash desk), Komercni banka 185 (103), Partners Banka 178 (0), CSOB 175 (64), Moneta 123 (41), Raiffeisenbank 116 (44), UniCredit 111 (43), Fio 86 (all), Creditas 33 (all), Air Bank 32 (0), mBank 29 (0), Oberbank 19 (17), Trinity 9 (2). CSOB coin machines down from 15 to 9 branches; KB has just one and will not expand.
signals.implies: 139 cash desks removed in ~17 months - each removal displaces cash into recyclers/assisted self-service. Core Printec recycler + cash-automation opportunity.
signals.followup: Map cash-desk closures to recycler deployment per bank.

signals.signal: CS's recycler fleet is OKI: KAL confirms CS deployed 250 OKI Cash Recycle ATMs (250th unit reached 15/03/2023), alongside NCR cash recyclers, all running KAL's multivendor Kalignite. Separately (30/05/2024) CS runs KAL Kalignite Hypervisor - Red Hat Linux virtualisation running Windows 10 as a guest OS - on hundreds of NCR machines, explicitly to avoid PC-core replacement and extend ATM hardware life; CS was the world's first bank to run Windows 10 on a Linux hypervisor ATM.
signals.implies: CS is a hard multivendor-software incumbency (KAL) with OKI+NCR hardware. Hypervisor strategy deliberately DELAYS hardware refresh - negative for pure hardware bids, positive for services/spares and for software-agnostic recycler supply.
signals.followup: Establish whether CS has extended Hypervisor to the OKI estate and when its NCR fleet finally ages out.

signals.signal: On 20/11/2025 the UOHS concluded that the 'Vklad na kartu' service run by CSOB, Ceska sporitelna and Raiffeisenbank does NOT breach competition or payment rules, expressly distinguishing it from the four-bank ATM-sharing project because it involves no network sharing/optimisation, only Mastercard/Visa-rails deposits at any participating bank's deposit ATM.
signals.implies: Regulatory green light removes the main blocker to further deposit-ATM interoperability - more banks can join, driving deposit-capable hardware demand.
signals.followup: Watch for a fourth bank joining Vklad na kartu.

signals.entity: Ceska sporitelna / CSOB / Raiffeisenbank ('Vklad na kartu')
signals.signal: Launch detail confirmed from CS primary release (04/06/2025): the service ran a pilot on ~40 ATMs, targeting 'more than a thousand' deposit ATMs. It runs on Mastercard MoneySend and Visa Direct rails, credits within 30 minutes, and supports virtual/digitalised Mastercard cards in mobile devices. 2024 deposit growth: CS +15% count / +8% value; CSOB +12.5% / +4.5%; Raiffeisenbank +14% / +6%.
signals.implies: Card-rails deposit switching, ATM application changes, dispute/AML monitoring on cross-bank deposits.
signals.followup: Get 2025/2026 deposit growth figures and the current Vklad na kartu device count.

signals.signal: H1-2026: 2.31m clients (+72,000 y/y); branches cut by 16 to 171; group loans CZK 945.8bn (+10.0%), deposits CZK 1,137.2bn (+10.2%); net profit CZK 8.5bn. KB+ (Temenos-based) had >75m logins and 18.4m transactions worth >CZK 200bn in Q1-2026 with >1.7m users. KB won the Celent Model Bank 2026 award in Core Banking Innovation for the Temenos migration and KB+.
signals.implies: Branch shrinkage plus client growth pushes cash to self-service; the completed core migration frees KB budget for channel/self-service investment.
signals.followup: Open KB's H1-2026 IR PDF for the ATM fleet line and 2026 capex on self-service.

signals.signal: H1-2026 (unaudited consolidated): net profit CZK 14.3bn (+11.7% y/y), operating profit CZK 18.1bn; clients +19,000 y/y; loan book +9.5%; 28% share of new mortgages. George Business already serves >10,000 corporate clients with full rollout promised by end-2026.
signals.implies: Corporate digital push at CS typically pairs with merchant cash-deposit / smart-safe demand.
signals.followup: Confirm CS ATM/deposit-ATM counts in the Erste/CS H1-2026 report.

signals.signal: CNB has formally adopted the TIBER-EU framework for threat-led penetration testing (announced 27/09/2024), tied to DORA. CNB will identify in-scope institutions at least annually and each must run an advanced red-team test at least once every three years, on live production systems covering critical or important functions. CNB is also running a DORA supervisory questionnaire, with the current data collection due 02/03/2026, and is aligning interpretation with NUKIB.
signals.implies: Recurring mandatory red-teaming across critical functions - ATM/POS/HSM estates and their managed-service providers are in scope. Security, HSM and resilient managed-services selling point.
signals.followup: Get the CNB list/criteria of TIBER-CZ in-scope institutions and the 2026 test wave timing.
